name: Sin and its Consequences
name_pt: O Pecado e as Suas Consequências
author: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning
desc: Manning's eight Lenten sermons of 1874, preached at the Pro-Cathedral, Kensington: the nature of sin, mortal sin, venial sin, sins of omission, the grace and works of penance, temptation, the dereliction on the cross and the joys of the Resurrection.
desc_pt: Os oito sermões quaresmais de Manning (1874), pregados na Pró-Catedral de Kensington: a natureza do pecado, o pecado mortal, o pecado venial, os pecados de omissão, a graça e as obras da penitência, a tentação, o abandono na cruz e as alegrias da Ressurreição.
editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1874)
edition: Sin and its Consequences (London: Burns and Oates, 1874), University of Toronto scan, Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The eight sermons; the contents and the publisher's advertisements are dropped.
